task.question: Which Japanese teammate finished second behind Kaori Sakamoto at the 2026 World Figure Skating Championships in Prague?
task.evidence: Sakamoto took to the ice to cheers from a packed arena in Prague and delivered a typically artistic and consistent final free skate to stay ahead of her Japanese teammate Mone Chiba.
task.page: Kaori Sakamoto wins 4th world figure skating title before retirement

answer:
The Japanese teammate who finished second behind Kaori Sakamoto at the 2026 World Figure Skating Championships in Prague is Mone Chiba. 

FINAL: Mone Chiba
